Overview Remy is a cheerful and tender-hearted girl, who lives with her mother in a French country town. One day, her father tells Remy that she isn’t their real daughter, and almost sold her to an evil slave trader. Vitaris, a strolling entertainer, helps Remy and discovers her talent for singing, and decides to take her in with his animal troupe, a monkey Georicoule and dogs Capi, Dolce, and Zelbino. Remy happens to meet her real mother and her son, Arthur during her journey and get to know each other, but Remy leaves for Paris without realizing that they are her real mother and brother. Vitaris then dies and left Remy alone to experience many hardships and difficulties one after another… Based on the children’s Literature “Sans Famille” by Hector Malot SEARCH CATEGORY Drama Classic Family Sport Action & Sci-Fi Comedy Theatrical Preschool ALL 2020s 2010s 2000s 1990s 1980s 1970s Contact Us HOME INFORMATION BUSINESS License Production PROGRAM COMPANY Message Company Outline Awards 50th Anniversary Contact Us Disclaimer Site Map ©NIPPON ANIMATION CO., LTD. Overview John is a cheerful and energetic young boy, who lives in a small coal-mining town in England. One day he finds a small dog lost in a flock of sheep, and takes her back home and names the puppy Lassie. Soon they become really good friends, just like real siblings. Lassie is a very lovely and smart dog, so everyone in the town loves her very much. But their happy life doesn’t last long. Suddenly a coal-mine owner closes his company because there is no more coal left. John request him a further investigation and being agreed, but in exchange for that, Lassie is taken to Scotland with the owner. Priscilla, his granddaughter and also John’s friend, cannot just stand by and let Lassie suffer in a cage, so She opens the cage and sets her free. Lassie sets out on a very long and hard journey from Scotland to home. Lassie keeps on running in order to meet John, her best friend and brother, as soon as possible… Based on the novel “Lassie Come-Home” by Eric Knight SEARCH CATEGORY Drama Classic Family Sport Action & Sci-Fi Comedy Theatrical Preschool ALL 2020s 2010s 2000s 1990s 1980s 1970s Contact Us HOME INFORMATION BUSINESS License Production PROGRAM COMPANY Message Company Outline Awards 50th Anniversary Contact Us Disclaimer Site Map ©NIPPON ANIMATION CO., LTD. Overview Romeo is an 11-year-old boy, who lives with his family in peaceful poverty in a small village in Switzerland. One day, Romeo decides to sell himself into slavery, because the money will enable his sick father to get the medical treatment he needs. An evil man named Ruini pays money for Romeo and takes him far away to Milan. Romeo is forced to become a chimney sweep. His life in Milan is hard, and his master’s family is always hard on him, but he also has a lot of good times with his best friend Alfred and the other chimney boys. Romeo and the chimney boys organize a group of chimney sweeps which they call “the “Black Brothers.” Based on the novel “The Black Brothers” by Lisa Tetzner SEARCH CATEGORY Drama Classic Family Sport Action & Sci-Fi Comedy Theatrical Preschool ALL 2020s 2010s 2000s 1990s 1980s 1970s Contact Us HOME INFORMATION BUSINESS License Production PROGRAM COMPANY Message Company Outline Awards 50th Anniversary Contact Us Disclaimer Site Map ©NIPPON ANIMATION CO., LTD. Eleven-year-old girl Nanami (means seven sea) travels the seven seas with her father and unique crews on an oceanographic vessel “Pepperoncino” to survey oceans and to search for the legendary luminous whale. Her closest companion Tico, an eight meter-long orca whale, also follows them and helps her to find the clues for the luminous whale and to learn about the symbiosis with nature. Overview One day, Sterling, a tender-hearted boy who loves animals, finds a baby raccoon in the woods and names him ‘Rascal’ and takes him home, where the baby raccoon becomes Sterling’s constant companion. Rascal grows up very well, but one day he gets a taste for sweet corn and begins to raid the neighbors’ corn gardens during the night. Sterling realizes that it is truly difficult for men and wild animals to coexist in the same place. After a misfortune befalls Sterling’s family and Sterling must to move, he decides to return Rascal to his natural life in the woods. Overview Based on the famous tale from The Thousand and One Arabian Nights, this story takes place more than 1200 years ago. The story’s hero is the impish Sindbad, a mischievous boy full of curiosity, who one night sneaks into the royal palace to watch the acrobatic performances and learns that a wide world awaits beyond Baghdad. Hearing of the travels of his uncle Captain Ali, Sindbad decides to become a sailor and travel around the world. Leaving behind a note to his father, young Sindbad boards Captain Ali’s ship and-accompanied by a myna called Sheila-sets out for the greatest adventure of his life. MAYA THE HONEY BEE Family Year : 1975 Eps : 52 ( 26min ) © NIPPON ANIMATION CO., LTD. Overview Maya, a newborn honeybee, brims with curiosity about the world around her. From the time she is born, it is difficult for her to understand and follow the strict rules of the hive because of her individuality and strong desire for independence. Having collected all the honey around the honeycomb, Maya decides to set out on an adventure to find a flower garden in order to collect more honey for the hive. Her intentions are noble, but because she leaves the hive without permission, the Queen sends Maya’s friend Willy to search for the little troublemaker. Willy joins Maya in her quest, and together, the two friends marvel at the sheer beauty that nature has to offer.
